title: Audit Entry Event Data
description: CloudEvent data payload for org.governancecommons.agent-matrix.audit.entry.v1. Emitted for every governed mutation, capability exercise, and policy decision requiring an audit record.

audit_entry_id.description: Unique ID for this audit record. Corresponds to audit_integrity.log_schema.audit_entry_id.

sequence_number.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number for hash chain integrity. Corresponds to audit_integrity.log_schema.sequence_number.

actor_agent_id.description: agent_id of the agent that performed the audited action.

actor_identity_subject.description: DID URI or key fingerprint of the actor, from actor's crypto_identity. Present when the actor has a crypto_identity declared in their dossier.

action.description: Description of the action performed (e.g., task.accept, artifact.write, capability.exercise, dossier.revoke).

target.description: Resource URI or identifier of the target that was acted upon.

timestamp.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of the audited action.

matrix_version.description: Semantic version of agent-matrix spec active at the time of the action.

previous_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the previous audit entry in the hash chain. All zeros for the first entry in a chain.

entry_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of this entry's canonical JSON (excluding entry_hash field). Used to verify hash chain integrity.

policy_basis.description: Reference to the policy or rule that governed the outcome (e.g., tool_permissions.deny, safety_constraints.sc-011).
